title: Ep 3 — OpenAI flags critical cyber risk, and the thirty-grand Reddit bot
description: OpenAI classifies its next model as having potential critical cyber capability and Claude Code ships self-hosted runners with cross-session agent messaging. Plus a deep dive on AI-powered community outreach backed by a real thirty-thousand-dollar-a-month founder story, and a quiet-news status check for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships.
